title: Apologizing to a Younger Sibling
paragraphs: Setelah membentak adiknya karena kesalahan kecil yang tidak sepenuhnya salahnya, Idris langsung merasa bersalah begitu melihat betapa terlukanya wajah adiknya.

Alih-alih membiarkan ketegangan itu berlarut tanpa diucapkan, seperti yang sering dilakukan keluarganya untuk konflik kecil, Idris menemui adiknya malam itu juga dan meminta maaf secara langsung, mengakui reaksinya tidak adil.

Adiknya tampak terkejut, menyebutkan bahwa kakak jarang meminta maaf secara langsung seperti ini di keluarga mereka, biasanya membiarkan perselisihan begitu saja memudar tanpa pengakuan dari pihak mana pun.

Hubungan mereka terlihat menghangat setelah percakapan itu, dan Idris menyadari bahwa permintaan maaf yang tulus, bahkan untuk hal kecil, seringkali memperbaiki lebih banyak daripada yang bisa dilakukan kesunyian.
answerKey: After snapping angrily at his younger brother over a minor mistake that was not entirely his fault, Idris felt an immediate wave of guilt once he saw how hurt his brother looked. Rather than letting the tension linger unspoken, as their family often did with small conflicts, Idris found his brother later that evening and apologized directly, admitting his reaction had been unfair. His brother seemed surprised, mentioning that older siblings rarely apologized so directly in their family, usually letting arguments simply fade away without acknowledgment on either side. Their relationship noticeably warmed after that conversation, and Idris realized that a sincere apology, even for something small, often repaired more than silence ever could.
